parameters.name: IncludeReservationData
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include renewal data. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: IsOrKey
parameters.description:
The logical operator between the filter conditions. Valid values:

*   **false** (default): **AND** Bandwidth plans that meet all filter conditions are returned.
*   **true**: **OR** Bandwidth plans that meet one of the filter conditions are returned.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description:
The information about the tags.

You can specify at most 20 tags in each call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn describe-cen-bandwidth-packages --include-reservation-data true --page-number 1 --page-size 2 --is-or-key false --resource-group-id rg-acfnwjeo4tv0000 --filter '[{"Value":["cen-xxjsjfkffkfkfjkf0000"],"Key":"CenId"}]' --tag Value=TagValue Key=TagKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cbn DescribeCenBandwidthPackages --region cn-hangzhou --IsOrKey false --Tag.1.Key TagKey --PageSize 2 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfnwjeo4tv0000' --PageNumber 1 --Filter.1.Value.1 'cen-xxjsjfkffkfkfjkf0000' --Tag.1.Value TagValue --IncludeReservationData true --Filter.1.Key CenId
